exposure: Cord blood DNA methylation (single CpG sites and CpG genomic regions)
outcome: Rapid weight growth at 1 year of age (defined with reference to WHO growth charts)
cohort: 2003 participants from six European-based child cohorts (ALSPAC, ENVIRONAGE, Generation XXI, INMA, Piccolipiu, and RHEA).
finding: Cord blood DNA methylation at specific CpG sites and genomic regions, along with gestational age acceleration, were significantly associated with rapid weight growth at 1 year of age, with some signals also linked to childhood overweight.
gest_age: Measured and used to calculate gestational age acceleration.
